bio: Known for killing two MTG members at once, earning the alias 'Mr. Shoot Up The Party.'
Member of OTF. Shot over 15 times by FBG Brick in 2017 but survived; has a prosthetic leg from the gunshot.
Imprisoned for four murders avenging his father; has racketed OTF Rex.
Became a hitman after Roc's death with an unknown body count. On his deathbed in the hospital, he confessed his murders to police and named his killer.
One of NLMB's founders.
One of NLMB's founders.
Used to enter WIIIC/O'Block to shoot with Torrance; did the same at Brick City.
Known for being merciless against SquirtTown; had relations with K.I. of STL.EBT.
Killed D-Thang of the 600 while shouting 'for Hottie,' to whom he was close.
Friends with Odee of WIIIC City.
Used to go to WIIIC/O'Block with 50 Shots to shoot; did the same at Brick City.
Kicked out of Jaro City; imprisoned for participating in Tyquan's murder.
Originally from Whiz City; known as a shooter who only targeted major figures.
Close to FYB J Mane; the 'JaJa Gang' was created in his honor.
Mentored many Tyquan World members; originally from 50 Strong, for whom he killed.
Shot Joey of O'Block, blinding him in one eye.
Close to Tyquan of Jaro City, K.I. of STL.EBT, and TB of Tyquan World.
Active shooter; snitched on D.Rose of the 600.
Switched from the Black Disciples of Welch World; with Dot of Tyquan World beat Lil Boo of the 600 and hit him with a shovel.
Twin brother of K.I.; represents both Tyquan World and STL.EBT.
Was in a relationship with the sister of GBE Capo and Doowop of Front$treet/NLMB.

Switched from Black Disciples in Welch World to IGD after Lil Jojo's death; allies with THF Twilla and Welch World members. Snitched on blood brother Marquise and Leland; paperwork released by TTB Reese in 2017.
Close to K.I. and Wooski.
Beat up numerous TYMB members.
Now paralyzed.
Killed Lil James of TYMB on the anniversary of CantGetRight's death to avenge CantGetRight's uncle Ty.
Lost a sister in a fire; close to Tooka. Racketed FBG Butta to recover King Yella's chain in 2014. Signed to Sony Records.
One of FBG's two founders; close to BossTrell with whom he did shootings together. Mentored K.I.
Very close to K.I., whom he called 'twin' despite no blood relation. Snitched on Lil Jay during his incarceration. Came closest of any gangster to killing Chief Keef.

Switched from 5th Ward through Jaro City to STL.EBT/IGD following Lil Jojo and Lil Jeff's deaths; tried joining Brick$quad 069 and the 600 but remained in Jaro with Lil Darrell and Gucci. Racketed by D-Thang in 2011; beat Emily of PNP, resulting in Edai placing a hit on him; with FBG Butta stole from FBG Duck and King Yella in 2014, prompting retaliation by Lucky and others. Left FBG to form own rap group WTO; accused cousin Butta of snitching.

Started the 'smoking on a dead enemy' trend, smoking on Lil Moe and Ty and Lil Chris. Cdai of the 600 copied his lyrics in 'Man Down.' Shooter against TYMB; racketed enemy OGs with Wooski and FBG Duck. Close to LaLa, L'A Capone's sister.
Won a murder trial; had at least two gunfights with Chicago police, boasting about them in his song 'B.O.N.' Shot and grazed by an AK-47 round at MOB Dooski's funeral in 2018 but recovered.
One of FBG's two creators; despite their sets being rivals, close to Lil Chris of TYMB and swore oaths on his name.
